plan.major: Outdoor Recreation in Parks and Tourism - Tourism Emphasis
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Outdoor Recreation in Parks and Tourism - Tourism Emphasis program page (poid=10894) and its linked official degree map, 'Outdoor Recreation in Parks & Tourism Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Tourism (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this program), last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (15/14/16/15/15/14/16/15) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BS Degree: 120. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C- (1.7) or better to be counted in the major, and students may gain credit through the National Outdoor Leadership School for ORPT 1542, ORPT 2040, ORPT 3040, and ORPT 4860 (signature of ORPT coordinator required). The catalog's Bachelor of Science Degree Requirement (12 credits, math or science) notes that a portion may be met by fulfilling the General Education Core and Breadth Areas, so the catalog blocks do not sum arithmetically to 120. ORPT 4890 Outdoor Recreation Internship is catalogued at 1-8 credits with 8 credits required in all; the map exercises it as two 4-credit rows (allow_repeated_courses set). The catalog Curriculum (73-76 credits) reconciles exactly: Core Courses 58-61 (its listed courses itemize to 45 fixed credits plus choice blocks of 13-16) + ORPT Electives 3 + Business Skills Course 3 + Hospitality Courses 6 + Supportive Knowledge Courses 3, and the map exercises every block (the two 3-credit 'Major Hospitality Course' rows exercise the 6-credit Hospitality block). Tourism's ORPT Electives list omits ORPT 1035, unlike the other ORPT emphases, and its elective slots carry the Tourism list as printed. The map's Fall Year 1 biology row prints 3 credits with no course number: at 3 credits it exercises the catalog choice's BIOL 2050 Southern Utah Flora value (the alternative BIOL 1010 + BIOL 1015 lecture/lab pairing totals 4); the slot carries all three courses. The map's Spring Year 3 rows print two ranges (Wilderness Medicine Course 1-3 and Free Electives 1-3); they are recorded at 1 (ORPT 1510) and 3, the combination that sums to the printed term total of 14. Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates them (MGMT 4100, ORPT 2800, ORPT 3030, ORPT 3050). Map free rows total 28 credits, recorded as printed (the catalog prints no free-elective figure).
